The FloPlast uPVC square union bracket is a robust black rainwater gutter component designed to join two lengths of square guttering securely. This high quality uPVC fitting offers a durable solution for both new build and refurbishment applications, ensuring efficient water drainage. Featuring an attractive rectilinear profile, the bracket includes newly extended unions to accommodate additional expansion and contraction, providing reliable performance. It is also compatible with most major guttering manufacturers, making it a versatile choice for professional installers seeking durable and functional gutter system components.
